subject.title: BL-ecommerce-catalog: Public Catalog — specs, aislamiento y tests

question: Should Public Catalog F1 include constants/categories/SEO, or should that surface be moved to the separate BL-ecommerce-seo block before validation?
rationale: The code shows SEO category data still has active consumers, but the issue and triage both identify its domain boundary as unresolved; automation should not decide that BL ownership before F2.

options.title: Validate boundary during F2
options.body: Proceed with F1 after correcting the known seed values and present constants/categories/SEO as an explicit owner flag before isolation or tests.

options.title: Move SEO categories to SEO block
options.body: Keep this block focused on catalog listing/search behavior and handle constants/categories/SEO under https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/issues/7104 if the owner classifies it as SEO routing/content.

options.title: Pause until child cleanups land
options.body: Wait for the child cleanup PRs linked from https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/issues/7131 and https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/issues/7132 before isolating affected rules.

recommendation.title: Validate boundary during F2
recommendation.body: Proceed with F1 after correcting the known seed values and present constants/categories/SEO as an explicit owner flag before isolation or tests.

likelyOwner.reason: AlexDiaz-Hamelyn is the named and assigned owner for this BL block and opened the related child catalog issues from the extraction pass.
